name: agentgateway
short_desc: MCP gateway that aggregates many MCP servers behind one endpoint
author: agentgateway
description: agentgateway is an agentic proxy that fronts any number of MCP servers and exposes them to clients as a single streamable-HTTP endpoint at /mcp, with a management UI at /ui. This app bundles two MCP servers as loopback-only sidecars — Grafana (dashboards, datasources, Prometheus/Loki queries, alerting) and Tailscale (devices, routes, ACLs) — plus the public Cloudflare documentation server, and seeds a ready-made config on first start. Further targets are added in the UI or by editing config.yaml in app-data.

form_fields.label: Grafana MCP bearer token
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically. Authenticates the gateway to the bundled Grafana MCP sidecar.

form_fields.label: Tailscale MCP bearer token
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically. The Tailscale MCP server rejects tokens shorter than 32 characters.

form_fields.label: Grafana URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of your Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.example.com/. Leave empty to disable the Grafana tools.

form_fields.label: Grafana service account token
form_fields.hint: Grafana → Administration → Service accounts. Viewer role is enough for read-only tools.

form_fields.label: Tailscale API key
form_fields.hint: tskey-api-... from the Tailscale admin console. Without it the Tailscale sidecar exits on start and its tools are skipped.

form_fields.label: Tailscale tailnet
form_fields.hint: Tailnet name, e.g. example.com or example.ts.net.

form_fields.label: Tailscale tool risk level
form_fields.hint: Highest risk level the Tailscale tools may reach. Leave at read unless you want the agent changing your tailnet.

form_fields.label: Grist MCP endpoint
form_fields.hint: Optional extra target, e.g. https://grist.example.com/api/mcp. Only added on first start, when this is set.

form_fields.label: Grist API key
form_fields.hint: Grist → Profile Settings → API key. Tools run as that user, under Grist's own access rules.
